description: This file defines middleware functions for request logging, 404 handling, and error handling in an Express.js backend, specifically for standardized JSON responses and audit logging.

methods.name: auditLoggerMiddleware
methods.description: Middleware that logs request start and end with details like method, path, userId, status, and duration.

methods.name: notFoundHandler
methods.description: Handles 404 Not Found errors by returning a standardized JSON response.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Centralized error handler that maps different error types to appropriate HTTP status codes and returns a standardized JSON error envelope.
